name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: Largest quake M6.1 off Japan on 6 Nov; no PAGER alerts or tsunami warnings
state: USGS recorded four earthquakes of M6 or above in the seven days to 7 Nov, the largest an M6.1 about 144km south-east of Hasaki, Japan, on 6 Nov and an M6.1 in the Fiji region on 5 Nov. There was no M7+ event, no PAGER orange or red alert and no tsunami warning.
rubric_hit: max magnitude 6.1 below the 7 Watch line

sources.title: USGS — M6.1, 144 km SE of Hasaki, Japan

why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
